source_evidence: Day331~11:00 exact player 'let not let them take our horses, attack' initiates hostilities, but does not specify V target, movement, attack mode, action sequence or finite feature expenditure. Preserve V's turn choice. Both sides mutually aware, no surprise. Fixed initial local combat grid (5ft cells, ordinary diagonal convention), along cartway x axis, positive y toward difficult downhill scrub: V(0,0), Cirren(-5,0), Fenar(5,0) at roadside verge; Mara/coach behind verge around(0,-10), healthy four horses harnessed farther along road. No forced Mara/horse movement or mechanical contribution yet. Dolly A(15,55), larger Dolgaunt D(0,65), Dolgrim B(-15,75), downhill hollow roughly10ft lower, dead deer, rocks/trunks situational cover not universal. Initial lines of sight unobstructed. All creature profiles fixed in preceding redraw, verified ERLW source blob5a16d86a3175eaeb333dec8900ee67a25c100d6f; no new monster identification in-character. Genuine initiative receipt: C16+2=18, B15+2=17, D6+4=10, A5+2=7, V1+5 (DEX4+Luckstone1)=6, F1+2=3. R1 Cirren moves from(-5,0) to(-5,15) costing30ft in difficult slope, elects immediate ranged offense because spread/out of Spirit Guardians reach, uses BA Spiritual Weapon level2 (3→2/3), summoned adjacent A at(15,50). +8 attack face11=19 vs AC15 HIT force d8(4)+5=9, A13→4. Action Toll the Dead (one-action cantrip allowed with BA leveled spell), A WIS save face4+0=4/DC16 FAIL, wounded damage2d12(11,6)=17 necrotic, A4→0 dead (hostile ordinary monster, no death save or declared nonlethal). SW active nonconcentration for up to1 minute. No Spirit Guardians or other slot. B independently reacts to threat, moves15ft uphill from(-15,75) to(-15,60), cost30ft, at45ft from C, throws one spear and fires one hand crossbow as part of its multiattack (only one spear and one loading crossbow discharge; third attack unavailable out of morningstar reach; no invented extra ammo or weapon). Disadvantage for both long range; spear faces16/18 keep16+4=20 vsAC19 HIT d6(6)+2=8 piercing, C51→43/51; spear now thrown, B hand crossbow faces15/11 keep11+4=15 MISS. No concentration save because SW nonconcentration. No reaction or resistance. D Dashes uphill from(0,65) to(0,25), cost80ft total on difficult ground, ends10ft from Cirren,25ft from V/Fenar, no attack this turn, no grapple. A dead before its initiative. Round1 V turn now, V and F have not acted; no V movement, attack, resource expense or speech beyond supplied order. Wilderness LR2/6→0/6 from Cirren's slot use and damage, no rest during combat, no full D331 provision charge. No enemy attacks against horses and no Mara repositioned. B and D alive/unhurt. Roll receipts actually executed; no additional dice.
